question: In a certain code language, ‘REJECT’ is coded as ‘57’.How will ‘POISON’ be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae9b181f448bbd290caa72889882d6a83ee2055de592a364c84273cc21ecb5fc.png] 

The pattern followed here is: Sum of the position value of each letter in the word - Number of consonants in that word.

So, 

 
• REJECT is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75b6d7b8a26c2b14a06800f98b16b526562b09610e2d93e29f2959862f9cf3c7.png] 

Similarly,

 
• POISON is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eefbd5078024413546ed8d085c47cd93dbe696ed686c6519ada80fee5da254c4.png] 

Hence, **"85"** is the correct answer.
